verdicts.reason: A: the CTA and the 'Online Only' badge are pushed into the bottom-right corner. The button is almost touching the bottom edge and the badge crowds it, leaving a large empty patch top right, so the layout feels bottom-heavy and stacked rather than read left to right. B keeps the original left-to-right banner flow, with the phone, a vertically centred text block and the CTA column. But the rotated badge is wedged under the button with only a few pixels between them, it sits close to the bottom edge, and the badge now competes with the CTA instead of leading into it.
